about: L4 material-zoo fixture and goldens (the test strategy, sections 3.1 and 3.3). Rendered by the exported viewer's --test-render at 640x360 with Stage.ZooCamera, the fixed test environment and light, no MSAA/TAA/FXAA; textures fetched through SessionAssets from this folder and decoded by the guarded decoder; PBR material assets read from this folder through MaterialSource; the PBR face shader (base colour, ORM, normal map, emissive, per-slot texture transforms) with the glTF overrides applied. The test stage has no reflection source, so fully metallic surfaces draw dark. Tolerance: the terrain goldens'. Goldens are proposed by the render script and approved by a person after viewing.

fixture.provenance: 64x64 images generated by Viewer.Shell.MaterialZoo.Pixels and encoded with LibreMetaverse 3.1.6's encoder (CoreJ2K); material assets written by MaterialZoo.Asset (LLSD XML holding the glTF document, as the grid serves them); layout, PBR material ids and the glTF override by MaterialZoo.Make(), RenderMaterials() and Overrides() (MaterialZooTests checks the files against them; NV_WRITE_MATERIAL_ZOO=1 rewrites them); the mesh cube is fixtures/meshes/mesh-cube-6face.llmesh
fixture.redistribution: generated in this repo; no third-party content
fixture.negative_control: --tr-alter=override: the zoo without its glTF override (the override box keeps its asset's texture, colour and rotation); must fail the diff

layered_fixtures.provenance: a 64x64 white image generated by Viewer.Shell.LayeredZoo.Pixels and encoded with LibreMetaverse 3.1.6's encoder (CoreJ2K); layouts by LayeredZoo.Make() and LayeredZoo.MakeWater() (LayeredZooTests checks the files against them)
layered_fixtures.redistribution: generated in this repo; no third-party content
layered_fixtures.cameras: Stage.LayeredCamera (--tr-camera=layered, layered-water): at LayeredZoo.Eye or WaterEye, looking east, level, 60 degrees
layered_fixtures.checks: at each probe the colour the blend arithmetic gives for the official viewer's order (LayeredZoo.Expected); goldens golden-layered-<backend>.png and golden-layered-water-<backend>.png, approved by the project maintainer after viewing

goldens.proposed: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 Ti; front row: base colour texture, factors only (sphere), metal (sphere), normal map, ORM texture; back row: emissive texture, texture transform, glTF override, mesh with PBR and legacy faces, legacy reference

NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 Ti; front row: legacy alpha mode none, blend, mask 128, mask 200, emissive; back row: legacy normal and specular maps (sphere), legacy normal map only, fullbright mask, PBR blend, PBR mask double-sided; furthest back: PBR mask single-sided

NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 Ti; blended panes before a grey wall, unlit except one: a wide red pane over a farther blue pane, a yellow pane inside a green blended box, a tube's outer face over its inner face seen across its hole, and a linkset's root pane over its lit child

NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 Ti; water seen from 1 m above it: a red pane crossing the water (its part above drawn after the water, its part below before it) and a green pane wholly under the water, before a wall grey above the water and black and white under it
